plugins.name: dev-kit
plugins.description: Spec-driven development, end to end. The spec settles what to build; a gitignored YAML plan settles how, and neither is rewritten to agree with the code afterwards. One question — dispatched subagents or inline — then the round runs without stopping: ready tasks go out in batches, in parallel where their files are disjoint, each a mandatory red-green-refactor round with a reproduction-first route for every fault. Wrap-up is two dispatched reviews at once, one against the spec and one on the code, fixed and re-reviewed to a ceiling of three rounds, ending in a verification report that shows the user how to reproduce it themselves. Plus init, which establishes the project's agent constraint system: AGENTS.md and layered docs, lint guardrails wired into CI, and the twin unit-test and e2e tracks. A SessionStart hook puts the bootstrap into every session.
